description: Multilingual continuous-latent speech synthesis with a Qwen backbone, flow-matching acoustic head, CAMPPlus speaker conditioning and an audio VAE.

request.name: template_name
request.description: Conditioning template; defaults to voice_design on that route, otherwise tts.

request.name: language
request.description: Target language name or code; defaults to the request's language (the server's top-level language field, the CLI's --language). Required by multilingual; ignored by dialect.

request.name: instruct
request.description: Voice description for voice_design; raw conditioning text for freeform or tts.

request.name: instruction_schema
request.description: Structured instruction field language; defaults to en for dialect, otherwise zh.

request.name: speed
request.description: Categorical speaking speed for the basic template, not waveform resampling.

request.name: pitch
request.description: Categorical pitch for the basic template.

request.name: volume
request.description: Categorical volume for the basic template.

request.name: emotion
request.description: Emotion label for the emotion template.

request.name: dialect
request.description: Dialect for the dialect template.

request.name: voice_id
request.description: Built-in English voice for the ip template.

request.name: reference_text
request.description: Transcript accompanying voice_ref; enables the acoustic reference prefix. Without a transcript, only speaker conditioning is used.

request.name: speaker_embedding_file
request.description: CAMPPlus embedding file or list, with shape [192] or [1, 192]. Supersedes voice_ref audio; zero_speaker_embedding takes precedence.

request.name: use_speaker_embedding
request.description: Condition on the reference speaker embedding.

request.name: zero_speaker_embedding
request.description: Use a zero projected speaker row instead of reference audio conditioning.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: Maximum generated acoustic patches per text chunk, also limited by the 512-position generation context.

request.name: guidance_scale
request.description: Flow guidance: conditioned prediction plus guidance_scale times its difference from the null prediction.

request.name: sigma
request.description: Flow SDE noise scale.

request.name: temperature
request.description: Flow sampling temperature; zero still uses seeded initial noise.

request.name: seed
request.description: Reference-posterior and generation noise seed.

request.name: raw_text
request.description: Send the text as one synthesis fragment without frontend chunking.

request.name: text_chunk_size
request.description: Framework long-form chunk budget in Unicode codepoints; default 50 when hanzi, kana and Hangul outnumber other letters and digits, otherwise 300 (120 for voice design and freeform, whose chunks after the first use the first generated chunk as their reference).

request.name: text_chunk_mode
request.description: Framework text chunking policy.

request.name: trim_silence
request.description: Trim trailing low-energy 100-ms frames per fragment, retaining a 300-ms tail.

session.name: reference_cache
session.description: Reuse prepared conditioning for the most recently used reference waveform.
